Application Materials.content:
All supporting documents including GMAT/ TOEFL/ IELTS scores must reach SMU by the stipulated application phase deadlines. Applicants should get ready contact details of two referrals for uploading and read the Applicant's Guide to Admission before submitting the application online.
How to Submit Your Application: complete the online application form and attach copies of the required documents as instructed. Keep a copy of your submission for your records. Your application will only be processed when all required documents have been received.
**Documents to submit**
1. Updated Resume
2. Undergraduate Degree Scroll
3. Undergraduate Degree Transcript
4. Any other supporting documents
5. SMU Admissions Test/GMAT/GRE
6. IELTS/TOEFL if undergraduate degree was not taught in English
7. Passport
8. Two References: please provide the name, email and contact number of two referees (they can be from your colleagues, superiors or friends). Referees will be notified to complete their referral forms online.
Applicants must also provide a personal statement explaining why they want to take the programme and how it fits with their career aspiration. Applicants are also required to provide contacts and details of two referees; an automated email upon submission of application will be sent to them to fill up the referral form.

Interview Requirements.content:
Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for an interview with the Admissions Panel. Interviews will be conducted between October to June for shortlisted applicants, and successful applicants will be informed within 1-2 weeks after the interview.
The application criteria state: “Shortlisted applicants will be invited for an online interview by members of the MSA Admissions Panel.”
FAQ: “Only shortlisted applicants are invited for a personal interview. This will allow us to assess the applicants holistically, taking into account his/her achievements in all areas and to select candidates who have the commitment, experience, motivation and potential to benefit from, and contribute to, the programme.” For international students, telephone interviews will be conducted if they are not in Singapore.

Application Deadlines.content:
The online application for the **August 2026 intake** starts **1 August 2025** with the following admissions phases:
- Phase 1 - **1 Aug to 31 Aug 2025** (Early Admission)
- Phase 2 - **1 Sep to 31 Dec 2025**
- Phase 3 - **1 Jan to 31 March 2026**
- Phase 4 - **1 Apr to 31 May 2026**
All supporting documents including GMAT/ TOEFL/ IELTS scores must reach us by the stipulated deadlines above.

Academic Requirements.content:
- Applicants must demonstrate **good prior academic performance in an undergraduate degree from a recognised institution of higher learning** / a **Good Bachelor's Degree**.
- Applicants must have sufficient background in **Accounting/Finance/Statistics/Business**; the application criteria also state applicants must have sufficient background in **Mathematics/Calculus**.
- Relevant working experience is not compulsory, but applicants with relevant/post-undergraduate working experience “will have an added advantage” and work experience “will be considered favourably by the MSA Admission Panel.”
- To assess sufficient background in Statistics/Accounting/Finance/Business, criteria include satisfactory completion of some mathematical courses at university level, completion of at least two mathematical courses at polytechnic level with **minimum B grade**, or an acceptable foundation in mathematics at GCE A-level or O-level or its equivalent.
- Applicants without a bachelor's degree are not eligible: “Our accreditation from the professional bodies specifically states that our applicants must have a bachelor's degree. Applicants without a bachelor's degree will not be eligible for the programme.”
- For SMU Admissions Test/GMAT/GRE exemption only: SMU Bachelor’s degree graduates with a **minimum cGPA of 3.0/4.0** within 5 years of graduation, and SUTD/NUS/NTU/SUSS/SIT Bachelor’s degree graduates with a **minimum cGPA of 3.5/5.0** within 5 years of graduation, are exempted; however, meeting the cGPA academic input does not guarantee acceptance.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- Applicants have the option to take [SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT)](https://masters.smu.edu.sg/sites/masters.smu.edu.sg/files/PDF%20docs/SMU%20candidate%20guide_refreshed.pdf) or GMAT or GRE as an admission test for application to the MSA programme.
- You are required to take an Admission Test for admission to the MSA programme, regardless of your academic background or prior qualifications. You may choose to take the GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test) / GRE (Graduate Record Examinations General Test), or the [SMUAT (Singapore Management University Admissions Test)](https://masters.smu.edu.sg/sites/masters.smu.edu.sg/files/PDF%20docs/SMU%20Admission%20Test%20Factsheet.pdf).
- If you have previously taken the GMAT or GRE, it must have been taken within **five years** of the date of your application submission.
- The following groups of candidates are exempted from GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test: SMU Bachelor’s degree graduates with a minimum **cGPA of 3.0/4.0** (within **5 years** of graduation); SUTD/NUS/NTU/SUSS/SIT Bachelor’s degree graduates with a minimum **cGPA of 3.5/5.0** (within **5 years** of graduation). However, meeting the cGPA academic input does not guarantee acceptance and candidates may still be asked to take the GMAT/GRE/SMU Admission Test.
- Official score reports can be sent via the following Institution Codes: GMAT: **F8D-3B-44**; GRE: **2861** (Department Code: **4001 - Accounting**).
- To enhance the competitiveness of your application, you should attain a **GMAT score of 600 or higher**, OR a **GMAT Focus edition score of 595 or higher**.
- To make your application more competitive, you should achieve a minimum **GRE combined score of verbal and quantitative components of 312**.
- GMAT score with a minimum score of at least **60 percentile for quantitative component** may be used in evaluating the applicant's background in statistics/accounting/finance/business.
- Candidates without GMAT/GRE or with low scores have the option to sit for the [SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT)](https://masters.smu.edu.sg/sites/masters.smu.edu.sg/files/PDF%20docs/SMU%20candidate%20guide_refreshed.pdf). However, if you don't sit for SMUAT, then we will need your GMAT/GRE score to assess your application. SMU's GMAT institution code for MSA is **F8D-3B-44**.
- GMAT/GRE scores are valid for **5 years** after the test date. If your GMAT/GRE results are older than **5 years**, you will need to re-sit your GMAT/GRE.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
Applicants must show proficiency in the English language. A **TOEFL (Min score: 90 or Band 4.5)** or **IELTS (min. score of 6.5)** test is required if the applicant's undergraduate degree was not conducted in English.
If your undergraduate studies were not taught in English, you must take the IELTS (International English Language Testing System) or TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language). An **IELTS (min. score of 6.5)** or **TOEFL (Min. score: 90 or Band: 4.5)** report is required. Either test must be taken within the last **two years** of your application submission. You will need to email the unofficial results of your test to the SMU Admissions Office and make a request at the relevant test centre to send your official score report to SMU.
All supporting documents including GMAT/ TOEFL/ IELTS scores must reach SMU by the stipulated application deadlines. Documents to submit include: IELTS/TOEFL if undergraduate degree was not taught in English.
SMU's institution code for TOEFL is **9014**; official score reports can be sent with TOEFL institution code **9014** (Department Name: Accounting).
TOEFL or IELTS test is required if the medium of instruction in your undergraduate or graduate education was not English. More information can be obtained from the [TOEFL](https://www.ets.org/toefl/) website and the [IELTS](https://www.ielts.org/) website. TOEFL/IELTS scores are valid for **2 years** after the test date.

Program Overview.content: The MSA is designed for professionals who are interested in developing expertise in applying data technology into their domain knowledge to solve business problems, especially in the finance and accounting sectors. The availability of massive amounts of data has created a high demand for skilled data analytics professionals who can analyse such data and obtain the insight needed for informed decision-making. This is extremely vital to accounting and financial services firms as they have been dealing with large amount of information produced by their clients.

Curriculum.content:
- Duration: **12-18 months full-time** (with flexibility to complete in 12 months) or **24 months part-time**.
- The MSA programme consists of **15 course units (CU)**, including **8 CUs Programme Core, 4 CUs Track Electives, 2 CUs Open Electives and 1 CU Professional Development Courses**, taught over 24 months on a part-time basis or over 12-18 months on a full-time basis, commencing in August of each calendar year.
- Full-time students may continue from August to January after Term 3 for an internship and/or global immersion programmes. Part-time students will be enrolled in the evening classes.
- Classes are conducted on weekday evenings from **7:00pm to 10:15pm** and on some Saturdays **8:45am to 12:00pm** and **1:00pm to 4:15pm**.
Programme Core - **8 CUs**:
- ACCT651 Managing Sustainable Value Creation
- ACCT686 Financial Reporting and Analysis in the IFRS World
- ACCT648 Applied Statistics for Data Analysis
- ACCT649 Programming with Data
- ACCT652 Data Management
- ACCT653 Forecasting and Forensic Analytics
- ACCT679 Visual Analytics for Accounting
- ACCT685 Accounting Processes and Analysis
Data and Analytics Track Electives - choose **4 CUs**:
- ACCT655 Analytics for Financial Instrument
- ACCT656 Analytics for Value Investing
- ACCT673 Data Governance and Quality
- ACCT684 Automation for Finance Transformation
- ACCT687 Sustainability Accounting and Analysis
- ACCT691 Corporate Financial Planning with Agentic AI
- ACCT680/681 Innovation and Technology Capstone (SMU-X) (0.5 CU + 0.5 CU)
Open Electives - choose **2 CUs**:
- Courses from MSA Programme curriculum
- Courses from other SMU Master Programmes (up to 2 CUs)
- Overseas immersion, exchange programme
Students are required to complete a minimum of **4 Track Electives** to complete Track requirements; the remaining **2 open electives** can be track elective, internship, overseas immersion or exchange programme, or courses from other programmes. Eligible students may complete the internship anytime during their course of study, provided the minimum of **10 weeks** is fulfilled.
Internship: students can choose a part-time internship assignment or full-time internship assignment by clocking at least **400 hours** to qualify for **1 course unit**. Part-time students and students with three-year relevant working experience and above will be exempted from the internship graduation requirement.
Full-time programme calendar:
- Aug-Nov: 5 Core Modules
- Nov-Dec: 1 Track/Open Elective
- Jan-Apr: 3 Core Modules and 1-2 Track/Open Elective
- Apr-Aug: 3-4 Track/Open Electives
- Jul-Nov: 1 Internship Elective and Professional Development Courses
Part-time programme calendar:
- Aug-Nov: 3 Core Modules
- Nov-Dec: 1 Track/Open Elective
- Jan-Apr: 1 Core Module and 1 Elective
- Apr-Jul: 1 Core Module and 1-2 Track/Open Elective
- Aug-Nov: 2 Core Modules
- Nov-Dec: 1 Track/Open Elective
- Jan-Apr: 2 Core Modules and 1 Track/Open Elective
- Apr-Aug: 2-3 Track/Open Elective and Professional Development Courses

Cost of Attendance.content:
Living expenses will vary depending on your lifestyle and accommodation. However, the average international student would be able to stay within a monthly budget of S$2000 - with change to spare. Estimated breakdown of basic living expenses:
| Item | Cost Per Month |
| --- | --- |
| **Accommodation** | **S$250 - S$800** |
| **Utilities** | **S$40 - S$100** |
| **Transportation** | **S$200** |
| **Telecommunications** | **S$50** |
| **Books & Stationery** | **S$200 per term** |
| **Personal Expenses (mobile phone, meals, etc)** | **S$100 - S$300** |
| **Food** | **S$300 - S$450** |

Financial Aid.content:
SMU MASTERS ASEAN Scholarship: The SMU MASTERS ASEAN Scholarship is to incentivize good applicants from ASEAN countries to pursue SMU Master’s Degree programs. One scholarship valued at **S$10,000 (inclusive of GST)** will be awarded for each Academic Year. Eligibility criteria: specialised in Finance; citizen of an ASEAN member country or observer nation (PNG and Timor-Leste); applicants must matriculate into the SMU Postgraduate programme (no deferment); excellent academic background; not a concurrent recipient of any other SMU-funded scholarships. Application is not required; it is awarded to students in the MSA Program after due consideration by the Programme Directors/faculty.
SMU Global Excellence Scholarship (**$30,000**): Eligibility criteria include Academic Excellence, generally with a minimum GPA of **4.5 out of 5.0** or equivalent in undergraduate studies; Leadership Potential; Global Perspective; and Personal Statement. Application is not required; it is awarded to students in the MSA Programme after due consideration by the Programme Directors/faculty during admissions interview, based on the criteria listed above. However additional scholarship interview may be required.
Merit Scholarship: Level 1: **$10,000** and Level 2: **$5,000**. Eligibility criteria include Academic Performance, generally with a minimum GPA of **4.0 out of 5.0** for the $10,000 level and **3.5 out of 5.0** for the $5,000 level; Professional Achievements; Extracurricular Involvement; and Personal Statement. Application is not required; it is awarded to students in the MSA Programme after due consideration by the Programme Directors/faculty, during admissions interview. However additional scholarship interview may be required.
Sustainability Scholarship (**$5,000**): Eligibility criteria include Interest in Sustainability; Academic Achievement, generally with a minimum GPA of **3.5 out of 5.0** or equivalent in undergraduate studies; Project Proposal; and Personal Statement. Application is not required; it is awarded to students in the MSA Programme after due consideration by the Programme Directors/faculty, during admissions interview. However additional scholarship interview may be required.
Entrepreneurship Scholarship (**$10,000**): Eligibility criteria include Entrepreneurial Experience; Academic Achievement, generally with a minimum GPA of **3.5 out of 5.0** or equivalent in undergraduate studies; Business Proposal; and Personal Statement. Application is not required; it is awarded to students in the MSA Programme after due consideration by the Programme Directors/faculty, during admissions interview. However additional scholarship interview may be required.
Leadership Scholarship (**$10,000**): Eligibility criteria include Leadership Experience; Academic Achievement, generally with a minimum GPA of **3.5 out of 5.0** or equivalent in undergraduate studies; Proven Leadership; Extracurricular Activities; and Personal Statement. Application is not required; it is awarded to students in the MSA Programme after due consideration by the Programme Directors/faculty, during admissions interview. However additional scholarship interview may be required.
EY Excellence Scholarship (External): Established in 2024, the objective of the EY Excellence Scholarship is to motivate exceptional postgraduate students in Singapore Management University’s School of Accountancy. One scholarship valued at **S$15,000 (inclusive of GST)** will be awarded for each Academic Year. Eligibility criteria: Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident; must matriculate into the SMU MSA Program (no deferment); good academic achievements (minimum cumulative GPA of **3.0**); while not a requirement, consideration will be given to postgraduates with demonstrated financial needs.
Lee Kuan Yew Scholarship (External): Applicants, who must be Singapore citizens, will be assessed holistically, including their track record of leadership and achievement and their potential to excel in their fields/professions, which will contribute to and benefit Singapore and society. Find out more about the scholarship [here](https://www.psc.gov.sg/scholarships/postgraduate-scholarships/lee-kuan-yew-scholarship).
Singapore Digital (SG:D) Scholarship (External): The SG:D Scholarship (Postgraduate) is an industry scholarship for individuals interested in pursuing ICM-related studies at the Masters or PhD level, including specialised ICM-related areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Analytics, Immersive Media, and Digital Content Creation. Applicants must be Singapore citizens; the postgraduate program has to be ICM-related and offered by a local autonomous university, local arts institution or renowned overseas university; and other listed eligibility criteria apply. The SG:D Scholarship is currently open for application and closes each year on **31 March**.
Indonesian Education Scholarship (LPDP) (External): LPDP is committed to preparing Indonesian future leaders and professionals through scholarships and encouraging research innovation through research funding. SMU has been recognised as an approved Masters/PhD destination for “all subject” under the LPDP 2023 programme. Please visit [LPDP](https://lpdp.kemenkeu.go.id/en/) for more information. Apply for the LPDP scholarship [here](https://lpdp.kemenkeu.go.id/en/beasiswa/pendaftaran-beasiswa/).
Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) Sponsorship (External): The OJK Sponsorship is offered to OJK employees who are keen to pursue a Master or Doctoral degree in SMU. OJK employees may contact their HR department to find out more about the sponsorship and eligibility criteria.
Financing options: The SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme offers Singaporeans aged 40 years and above the opportunity to receive the SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) Top-up of **S$4,000** to help offset out-of-pocket tuition fees, starting from the Academic Year 2024/2025 intake, commencing on or after **1 May 2024**. Up to **90% course fee subsidies are not eligible for MSA programme**. Singapore Citizens with eligible Post-Secondary Education Account (PSEA) may utilize balance funds for tuition fees.
Discount schemes:
| **SMU Discount Scheme** | **Eligibility** | **Amount** | **Exemption Discount*** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SMU Alumni Discount | SMU UG/PG alumni | $8,000 | Up to 4 CUs exemption at $3,000 each (for alumni of local AUs and PUs) |
| SC/PR | Singapore Citizens/ Permanent Residents | $5,000 | |
| Partner Universities and Local AUs (SMU/NUS/NTU/SIT/SUSS/SUTD) | Partner Universities and Local AUs | $4,000 | |
| ASEAN | ASEAN nationals | $3,000 | |
| Corporate | Corporate Partners | $6,000 | |
*Only for specifically identified exempted courses with prior studies at PU/SMU, typically requiring a satisfactory performance for recognition. Note that exemptions may result in ineligibility of professional accreditations. Each student is only eligible for one discount. Should a student qualify for more than one discount, only the higher discount will be applicable. Terms & Conditions Apply.
Selected scholarships are available for MSA programme and will be used to offset tuition fees. Scholarships are awarded based on merit and evaluated using several factors, including prior academic performance, admission test scores, employment history, anticipated contributions to the program, interview results, and career aspirations. Note: Not all students will receive the scholarship.

Deferral Admission Policy.content:
- SMU MASTERS ASEAN Scholarship: applicants must matriculate into the SMU Postgraduate programme (**no deferment**).
- EY Excellence Scholarship: applicants **must matriculate into the SMU MSA Program (no deferment)**.
